_comment: Configuration for `pnpm perf:xproc:gate` — see bench/xproc-gate.ts and docs/design/perf-gates.md.
_node: Shards must run on this node major, all on one exact version. The round counts below were sized on it; moving it means re-deriving them.
_rounds: Rounds PER SHARD; CI runs 20 shards, so 100 rounds per case, 160 for graphql/document, json/document, rollback/none and rollback/dense, and 900 for the three cases that are bimodal per process on Node 26 (css/stylesheet, expected/narrow, rollback/medium). The bimodal cases are sized from REAL planted costs on Node 26: expected/narrow, the binding one, is caught 0.80 of the time at 900 rounds at +1.7%. The others are sized from the shift model on a pooled 430-850 rounds per case. See docs/design/perf-harness-interleaving.md.
_alpha: Per case, split between the median sign test and the mean sign-flip test; a case fails if either does.
_warmup: A worker warms for BOTH the parse count and the time. A count alone stopped some processes before V8 finished tiering: css/stylesheet ran 14% faster after 1.5 s of warm-up than after 40 parses, and that difference varies between processes.
